book.name: Ibulu
book.title: Ŋwa' wvù bó to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ Bo'ibulu

content: Ɛkumɛ cee ncese wvù Mɛlkisɛdɛk

Mɛlkisɛdɛk wvun to nu Nfon wvu Salɛm, bvuu nu cee ncese Nyo' wvù nu Ɛkolɛ ke Mwɛɛm Mvunciim e. Ɛ ɛ̀ ke no nu kefew kemew e, ɛ Abla'am laa jem yuwyɛ bonfon nteen. Ɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛk ke tasɛn bô wvú no wvú to kfuuyi, mum laŋ kembonɛn yî ye le.

Ɛ Abla'am gaw mwɛɛm mvunciim mvù wvú to yowɛɛ gbwen jem e biba yuufe, nya keba kemwaaŋ ɛ̂ Mɛlkisɛdɛk. Cee ncese wvun nu ɛ diee diew duŋci mwɛɛm mvunfɛɛm. Fi fwe nu lɛ wvú nu “Nfon wvu Teytey” no diee diew dì Mɛlkisɛdɛk duŋci. Ɛ fì bii fó nu lɛ wvú nu “Nfon Nyɛkeey” njefo wvú to nu Nfon wvu Salɛm.
Kɛ wee kee ice bô bwee kɛnɛɛ kfuu diew kɛ. Ɛ kɛ wee kee tɛn seke bó to bokɛɛ wvú kɛnɛɛ seke wvú to kpweɛ kɛ. Wvú nu cee ncese wvù mɛy lo diɛwɛ Waa Nyo' le.

Ben kɛ etaa eyɛn wee wvù ɛ̀ to nu Mɛlkisɛdɛk wvun! Wvú to nu naa lo wee ɛ wvú kuuke. Naa ɛ Abla'am wvù to nu cee kfuu di bonyii bo Islael e ke yow mwɛɛm gbwen jem e to dvú gaw biba yuufe, mum nya lo kemwaaŋ ɛ̂ wvú.

Fi ɛkumɛ boom bo Lɛwe le bò to ké no lemte lemme di bocee ncese le nu ɛ bvudvuu bvumew to jemyi ɛ̂ bonci bo Muses e lɛ bó efiì mwɛɛm ɛ̂ bonyii bo Islael keba kemwaaŋ ɛnte jo yuufe, naa no bonyii ban to cim nu boom bo bwee bó le, ɛ bó bocii nu boom bo Abla'am e.
Kɛ wee wvun to nu wee kfuu di Lɛwe le kɛ. Geenɛn ɛ ɛ̀ fi wvú mwɛɛm ɛ̂ Abla'am keba kemwaaŋ ɛnte jo yuufe, laŋ kembonɛn yî ye le, ɛ Abla'am nu wee wvù Nyo' to geɛ ŋkawma ɛ̂ wvú.
Kɛ ɛ̀ nu kemaŋɛn lɛ wee wvù laaŋke kembonɛn yî wee mvu le kuuke fele wee wvù wvú laaŋke kembonɛn yî ye le kɛ.

Bocee ncese bo ɛ̂ kfuu di Lɛwe le ban to fii mwɛɛm ɛ̂ bonyii keba kemwaaŋ ɛnte jo yuufe, ɛ bó bodvu bò fii nu bonyii ɛ bó kpwee. Geenɛn Mɛlkisɛdɛk wvù to fiɛ mwɛɛm keba kemwaaŋ ɛnte jo yuufe ɛ̂ Abla'am nu ɛ Ŋwa' Nyo' seŋe ɛ̂ beene lɛ ɛ̀ nu wee ɛ wvú to fele.
Ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ bó egay lɛ Lɛwe kebɛɛ wvù kfuu diew to fii mwɛɛm ɛ̂ bonyii keba kemwaaŋ ɛnte jo yuufe to nu ɛ nya mwew mwɛɛm ɛ̂ Mɛlkisɛdɛk can Abla'am e.
Bó nulo egay nonɛn njefo seke Mɛlkisɛdɛk to tasɛnɛɛ bô Abla'am nu ɛ wvú wvù Lɛwe to bɛɛ ɛ̂ bvulɛw bvu Abla'am wvù ɛ̀ to nu icee cee cee bó le.

Ɛ́ ɛ̀ fɛn to nu lɛ lemme dì kfuu di Lɛwe le to gee diɛwɛ bocee ncese le to nu ɛ kocɛn keege ɛ́ bonyii enu teytey ɛ̂ Nyo' ɛjise, tu shiee wvumvu cee ncese to bee ebvuu enu wvu la? Beene kee lɛ Nyo' to nya bonci ɛ̂ bonyii bo Islael bii lemme dì bocee ncese bo ɛ̂ kfuu di Lɛwe le to gee. Fí dioo nu nonɛn, bó kaa ɛ gay lɛ wvuwɛ cee ncese kɛŋke keeke enù ɛ̂ je yì Mɛlkisɛdɛk nu jó le, ɛfey keenu ɛ ɛ̀ nu ɛ̂ je yì cee ncese wvu ɛ̂ kfuu di Ɛlon e nu jó le nɛɛ le?
Beene kee lɛ kfuu di bocee ncese le ké kumene, ɛ fí no nu shiee le keekumɛn tɛn bonci.
Wee wvun wvù beene jemyi ɛkumɛ wvú, nu ɛ wvú to buy ɛ̂ kfuu dimew e jɛɛy, ɛ wee ke baa yuu buy wase ɛ̂ kfuu didvu le elemte fô ketaŋ ke ncese le kɛ.
Wee wvun nu Tata wesebeene. Ɛ ɛ̀ nu kecɛɛy lɛ wvú to buy ɛ̂ kfuu di Juda le. Ɛ Muses to ke baa yuu jeme fiɛɛ ɛkumɛ kfuu din seke wvú to jemyi ɛkumɛ bocee ncese kɛ.
Jisos nu cee ncese ɛ̂ je yì Mɛlkisɛdɛk nu jó le
Fiɛɛ fin fì beene jemyi ɛkumɛ fí nu ɛ loocɛ ɛ duŋcɛ ye no cee ncese wvumvu nu ɛ buy wase diɛwɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛk e.
Wvú nu ɛ nɛ ɛ tu cee ncese ɛ ɛ̀ yaa nu ɛ̂ je yì nci jemyi le no wee kɛŋke keenu ɛ̂ kfuu di bocee ncese le kɛ. Wvú nu cee ncese ɛ ɛ̀ nu yî mvuŋgay mvu nshii wvù yaa kaa kɛ le.
Ɛ̀ nu fiɛɛ fì bó nu ɛ saŋ ɛkumɛ wvú lɛ,

content.text: “Wo nu cee ncese wvù mɛy lo ɛ̂ je yì Mɛlkisɛdɛk nu jó le.”

content: Fí ɛ mum ɛ no nu lɛ, je yi yvum yì bó to gee mwɛɛm jó nu ɛ bó ɛ fuwyɛ wase yiyɛ, njefo kɛ yí bvuu kɛŋke mvuŋgay kɛnɛɛ lemme kɛ.

[Kɛ bonci bo Muses e to ké ge fiɛɛ ɛ fí joŋ gɛn mɛse kɛ.] Geenɛn, keseen nu ɛ Nyo' ɛ duŋcɛ wase je yì jee ntay yì beene egɛɛlè bvufee yî dvú le yì fele yiyɛ. Ɛ̀ nu yí yì beene fele jó sɛ too nceencee fô Nyo' le.
Ɛ keebvuu ebise fó nu ɛ Nyo' to dioo gɛɛle cee ncese je yi fiɛ yin, die kelew, ɛ kɛ wvú to ké die kelew seke wvú to gɛɛle bomew ba kɛ.
Geenɛn, ɛ wvú ke dioo gɛɛle wvun, die kelew ɛkumɛ wvú gay lɛ,

content.text: “Me wvù Tata nu ɛ me ɛ ndie kelew,
ɛ kɛ me nu ŋke eŋkumɛn diɛw yɛm kɛ,
‘Wo nu cee ncese wvù mɛy lo.’”

content: Kelew kè Nyo' to dieɛ kin ɛ mum ɛ duŋcɛ lɛ Jisos nu wee wvù nu ɛ ge moŋkan mo monfɛm man ɛ no leeme tɛmyi fele mo moyvuum.
Bocee ncese bò to shee nu fwele to ké no nu nteen, njefo kɛ kpwe to nulo ecinɛ wee le ɛ́ wvú emɛy egee lemme diew di kecee ncese le kɛ.
Geenɛn, Jisos ɛ no nu fiew cee ncese sekecii njefo kɛ nshii we kɛŋke kendvuse kɛ.
Nonɛn, wvú nulo eboysee bonyii sekecii bò benci too fô Nyo' le fele can ye le. Ɛ wvú boysee nonɛn, njefo wvú nu dvú sekecii lɛke Nyo' fô bó le.

Fí nu lɛŋ lɛ beene ekɛŋkè kfuu kekiɛ ɛkolɛ ke bocee ncese le. Wvú nu fiew wee wvù yuule, ɛ wvú baa kɛŋke jay kɛnɛɛ nlom yî ye le kɛ. Wvú nu fiew ɛ Nyo' ɛ gawsɛn wvú fô bonyii bo bibefɛ le. Nyo' nu ɛ bense wase wvú, wvú ɛ ben naa ɛ fey ɛbulɛ ɛ gɛn fowe.

Kɛ wvú kɛŋke fiew shiee keegee boncese diɛwɛ bikuu bi bocee ncese le, bì to ké no gee boncese ɛdiuw ɛcii kɛ. Ɛ bó to ké dioo gee yaw ge fô bikuu bibole, keekpwaŋsɛn bibole bibefɛ, sɛ ke no gee fô bi bonyii le. Wvú to ge fiew we ncese kaŋ mwaaŋ no wvú to nyaɛ ɛkolɛ kew keetaŋe bonyii dvú.

Yî kefew ke bonci bo Muses e nu ɛ bó to baale naa ɛ ɛ̀ nu bonyii ɛ bó wɛɛyi yî nyam ye le lɛ bó enù bikuu bi bocee ncese le. Geenɛn, ɛ ɛ̀ ke dioo nu wase ɛjim jo bonci ban, ɛ Nyo' ge ŋkawma die kelew, mum baa wase ɛ ɛ̀ nu Waa we wvù wvú nu ɛ ge wvú ɛ no jee gɛne mɛɛse sekecii.

footnotes.text: Salɛm nu lɛ, “Nyɛkeey” ɛ ɛ̀ nu diee di kelaante kè Jɛlusalɛm e, ɛ bó ɛ ci lo.
